subject.title: fix: compaction usage guards and agent-loop turn correctness

question: Should per-turn session refresh extend the existing `AgentOptions.prepareNextTurn` contract, or should `prepareNextTurnWithContext` become a second permanent plugin API with explicit precedence?
rationale: The branch changes the exported plugin SDK and establishes a lasting callback ownership boundary; tests can validate either design but cannot choose the public contract.

options.title: Extend the canonical hook
options.body: Add optional turn context to the existing callback in a backward-compatible form and keep one preparation path for internal and external consumers.

options.title: Approve the parallel hook
options.body: Keep `prepareNextTurnWithContext`, document its precedence and intended audience, and add compatibility tests covering consumers that provide either or both callbacks.

recommendation.title: Extend the canonical hook
recommendation.body: Add optional turn context to the existing callback in a backward-compatible form and keep one preparation path for internal and external consumers.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest recent history in this agent-session and compaction surface and are carrying the current API change.
